description: Defines the Tables class that extends Drupal's core entity query tables to support workspace-specific revisions and associations in Drupal's workspaces module.

classes.name: Tables
classes.description: Extends core Tables to modify entity query behavior for workspaces, handling workspace associations and revisions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tables object, setting workspace info service and workspace association table if active workspace ID is present.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Overrides addField to ensure revision tables are used when querying workspace-specific revisions.

methods.name: addJoin
methods.description: Overrides addJoin to modify join conditions for workspace-specific revisions using COALESCE.

methods.name: addNextBaseTable
methods.description: Overrides addNextBaseTable to add workspace tracker join if the entity type supports workspaces.

methods.name: addWorkspaceTrackerJoin
methods.description: Adds a join to the workspace_association table for an entity base table to include workspace-specific revisions.
